description:
Operating Area:
Summer 2026: Corsica

YLIME is the epitome of luxury and elegance, a Sunreef 60 that exudes character and style. Available for charter, this stunning catamaran boasts a clever layout, offering plenty of space to unwind or gather with friends and family. Inside, refined textures and subtle marble accents create a serene atmosphere, perfect for relaxation.

The yacht features four luxurious en-suite cabins, accommodating up to 8 guests. The spacious master suite on the port side offers generous dressing space and a large bathroom. To starboard, three comfortable guest cabins with queen-sized beds provide a restful retreat. The open-plan main deck includes a galley-up layout with a dining area, fostering a homely and welcoming ambiance.

YLIME’s expansive exterior spaces include ample sunpads on both the front terrace and flybridge, providing endless opportunities to soak up the sun. The aft deck features a cozy alfresco dining area, and the hydraulic swimming platform offers easy access to the water. Equipped with state-of-the-art water sports gear and staffed by a professional crew of three, YLIME is sure to exceed every expectation, ensuring an unforgettable charter experience.

crew.name: Lawrence Bouveron
crew.bio:
Nationality: French
Languages: English, French, Spanish

Captain Lawrence is an experienced professional seafarer with a strong background in high-end yachting and charter operations, specialising in international sailing on catamarans and motor yachts. With solid experience as both Captain and First Mate, he brings a confident, hands-on approach to vessel operations, guest management, and navigation across a variety of cruising areas.

His experience includes private and day charter operations, long-distance deliveries, offshore and coastal sailing, technical maintenance, and oversight of refit periods. Having worked across areas including Southern Corsica, Sardinia, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, and the Caribbean, Lawrence combines practical seamanship with a strong sense of responsibility and a calm, service-focused attitude on board.

Accustomed to high-end guest operations, Lawrence is confident in itinerary planning, harbour manoeuvring, anchoring, safety procedures, and daily vessel preparation. Multilingual and adaptable, he brings strong client relations, operational reliability, and a professional presence that makes him well suited to both private and charter yacht environments.

crew.name: Christophe Bouchaux
crew.bio:
Nationality: French
Languages: Italian, English, French

Hailing from Nice, Christophe brings over 15 years of experience as a yacht Chef and crew member, having worked aboard both motor and sailing yachts across the Mediterranean. His cuisine is rooted in French and Mediterranean traditions—fresh, elegant, and always tailored to the preferences of guests.

With a calm and professional demeanor, Christophe is as comfortable in the galley as he is provisioning in the bustling markets of Saint-Tropez or navigating the logistics of busy charters. His strong sense of organization, attention to detail, and passion for well-crafted meals, ensuring every dining experience on board is both refined and memorable.

crew.name: Diane Le Boulch
crew.bio:
Nationality: French
Languages: English, French, Spanish

Diane is an experienced yachting and hospitality professional with a strong background in guest service, onboard support, and day-to-day vessel operations. She brings a practical, service-led approach to her work and takes pride in creating a welcoming, comfortable, and well-organised environment on board.

With experience across motor yachts, catamarans, and charter operations, Diane has developed strong skills in guest care, interior upkeep, stock management, provisioning, and premium service. Her background in both onboard roles and shore-based hospitality has shaped a well-rounded profile, allowing her to adapt easily and support the smooth running of life on board.

Reliable, versatile, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, Diane brings a positive attitude and a strong hospitality mindset to her role. Her multilingual communication skills, charter experience, and hands-on approach make her a valuable addition as a Stewardess.
